prompt:
Edit image1's COMPLETE eight-pose Borrin actor-only sheet together. Preserve every pose's exact head, torso, clothing, chair, seated boot positions, camera, body size, order and four-column/two-row layout. Change ONLY the arms' contact height: the pointing anatomical RIGHT index finger (image-left hand) and resting anatomical LEFT palm (image-right hand) are currently about25 pixels TOO LOW at640-frame scale, sitting below the imaginary tabletop and on his lap. Raise BOTH forearms/hands smoothly by that amount (roughly half a fingertip length in source) by modest natural elbow bend, without moving shoulders/body/chair/feet. The downward pointing finger remains extended, not a fist. Its tip must now sit ABOVE the belt rather than level with/below it. Resting left palm must also sit above belt with fingers lowered gently onto an imaginary page, not onto thigh.
Keep the eight differing head lean and finger-reading beats unchanged, the same steady seated floor. Image2 shows the actual independent desk/book at the matched640-frame body scale: right fingertip contacts cream LEFT page around(235,339), left palm contacts cream RIGHT page around(396,346). Those positions are purpose, not scenery to add. The existing entire body image would be anchored at(320,616) and650 standing-equivalent scale, so correct hands rather than moving whole dwarf up. Hands are near the waist but visibly ABOVE belt for this contact. Every frame has both hands at that correct open-book height, including lean4 and final7. Image3 is the original approved writing actor identity/arm height. Preserve the same detailed dwarf rendering and skin/clothes, true transparent alpha. No desk, book, pen, coins or ground. Eight complete distinct poses with ample gutters and no neighbor fragments, no cropped boots/hands. This is a small upper-arm/forearm pose edit, no camera/scale/identity change.

editHistory.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit image1's exact eight-frame Borrin ledger review sheet into an ACTOR layer for an independently rendered desk. Retain all EIGHT distinct ordered poses in the SAME four-column/two-row layout. Keep Borrin's head, spectacles, two short grey beard braids, swept-grey hair, red cravat, embroidered dark waistcoat, cream shirt, sleeves, hands, pointing fingers and camera. Remove ONLY the entire wooden desk, drawers, legs, ledger, inkwell, quill and stacked books from every cell, leaving genuine transparency. Keep Borrin seated on his own wooden chair. Reveal his trousers/stocky knees and leather boots naturally where the desk concealed them. Image2 is the existing approved seated actor sheet: use exactly this Borrin identity/body proportions/chair/boot quality and matching camera/scale, but image1's different looking-down and leaning phases and empty pointing fingers.
His anatomical RIGHT index finger (image LEFT) traces down an imaginary OPEN ledger page at the ORIGINAL image1 tabletop height. Left palm and fingers (image RIGHT) rest at the ORIGINAL imaginary right-page height. Do not move either hand down onto his lap, grip anything, add a quill, or turn the fingertips into fists. Keep right pointing finger extended and left fingers relaxed over imaginary page. Frame1 begins with finger at upper page, frames2-3 trace a short entry down the page, frames4-5 lean down to read, frames6-7 straighten, frame8 finishes pointing at the entry. Maintain small smooth pose changes and the SAME seated floor/body size, steady boots, head readable in all8. No changing chair scale or view. This is a finite one-entry review, not a walk, dance or broad gesture.
Transparent background, generous gutters around all8 whole figures, no desk/table/book/ink/quill/coins/tools/shadows/text/scenery. Semi-realistic detailed production render identical to current Borrin asset, clean natural edges. No duplicated poses. Author all eight together.
editHistory.method: Built-in whole eight-pose edit, fixed camera and one shared physical scale; approved seated identity reference. Whole-cell extraction only.
editHistory.scope: Candidate seated reference action at independently owned original desk. Native finger/page and stationary boot checks plus actual finite playback are required before approval.
